## 🌡️ MARKET OVERVIEW

**1. What is the prevailing Global Risk Regime?**
RISK-OFF. Breadth: 2/11 sectors positive. Confirmations: Financials and Industrials both negative and only Energy and Utilities showing net positive 1W performance; Leadership: Concentrated (Top 5 across 3 sectors).

**2. Which sectors are leading?**
Energy leads: XOM ABOVE TREND (1W: +3.25% | 1M: +1.03%), CVX ABOVE TREND (1W: +3.62% | 1M: +6.96%), COP ABOVE TREND (1W: +4.12% | 1M: +10.46%). Materials showing pockets: DOW ABOVE TREND (1W: +10.04% | 1M: +8.98%), APD RECOVERY (1W: +5.80% | 1M: -1.76%). Technology strength concentrated in cap-weighted names: AMAT ABOVE TREND (1W: +5.17% | 1M: +0.61%), LRCX RECOVERY (1W: +6.46% | 1M: -9.64%).

**3. Which sectors are lagging?**
Consumer Discretionary lagging with AMZN CORRECTION (1W: -2.60% | 1M: +1.76%) and TSLA BELOW TREND (1W: -1.39% | 1M: -8.66%). Financials weak: JPM BELOW TREND (1W: -2.09% | 1M: -8.81%), WFC BELOW TREND (1W: -7.86% | 1M: -16.69%). Industrials soft with GE BELOW TREND (1W: -7.11% | 1M: -4.34%) and BA BELOW TREND (1W: -9.18% | 1M: -11.16%).

## 📈 STOCK PERFORMANCE

**4. Top Performing Stocks?**
Top 5: DOW ABOVE TREND (1W: +10.04% | 1M: +8.98%), OXY ABOVE TREND (1W: +7.32% | 1M: +23.11%), LRCX RECOVERY (1W: +6.46% | 1M: -9.64%), APD RECOVERY (1W: +5.80% | 1M: -1.76%), INTC RECOVERY (1W: +5.41% | 1M: -5.22%). Leadership: Concentrated (3 sectors in Top 5), signaling pocketed gains rather than broad market rally.

**5. Worst Performing Stocks?**
Bottom 5: GE BELOW TREND (1W: -7.11% | 1M: -4.34%), TMO BELOW TREND (1W: -7.40% | 1M: -11.83%), SYK BELOW TREND (1W: -7.62% | 1M: -7.40%), WFC BELOW TREND (1W: -7.86% | 1M: -16.69%), KHC BELOW TREND (1W: -7.99% | 1M: -8.13%). Weakness concentrated in Industrials, Healthcare and Financials.

**6. Momentum Stocks?**
Strongest 1W movers: DOW (1W: +10.04%), OXY (1W: +7.32%), LRCX (1W: +6.46%), APD (1W: +5.80%), INTC (1W: +5.41%). Note MAJOR divergence: several large-cap techs showing 1W recovery vs 1M weakness (LRCX RECOVERY, INTC RECOVERY, NVDA RECOVERY) — watch for trend break rather than broad accumulation.

## 🏭 SECTOR OUTLOOK

**7. Technology Outlook?**
Tech is mixed and under pressure overall with several short-term bounces: AAPL BELOW TREND (1W: -2.85% | 1M: -9.21%), MSFT BELOW TREND (1W: -3.28% | 1M: -1.96%), NVDA RECOVERY (1W: +1.37% | 1M: -5.15%), AMAT ABOVE TREND (1W: +5.17% | 1M: +0.61%). Sector breadth weak (majority of 24 stocks down on 1W), so chip supplier strength is idiosyncratic, not broad-based.

**8. Financials Outlook?**
Financials are broadly weak: JPM BELOW TREND (1W: -2.09% | 1M: -8.81%), V BELOW TREND (1W: -3.22% | 1M: -6.71%), MA BELOW TREND (1W: -4.66% | 1M: -7.34%). Sector breath fragile (20-stock group largely negative) and earnings/news have increased tail risks.

**9. Healthcare Outlook?**
Healthcare is soft with headline losers and operational risks: JNJ ABOVE TREND (1W: +0.47% | 1M: +0.81%) is a relative safe-haven, while LLY BELOW TREND (1W: -0.53% | 1M: -2.81%) and SYK BELOW TREND (1W: -7.62% | 1M: -7.40%) show vulnerability; sector breadth tilted negative (majority of 17 stocks down).

## 🧭 PORTFOLIO STRATEGY

**10. Portfolio Recommendation?**
In RISK-OFF conditions favor defensive exposures and select energy/commodity cyclicals: XOM ABOVE TREND (1W: +3.25% | 1M: +1.03%), CVX ABOVE TREND (1W: +3.62% | 1M: +6.96%), and DOW ABOVE TREND (1W: +10.04% | 1M: +8.98%). Reduce exposure to broad growth/high-multiple tech and weak financials while monitoring tech recovery signals for confirmation.

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

**11. Stocks to Watch Next Week?**
BULLISH: COP ABOVE TREND (1W: +4.12% | 1M: +10.46%), APD RECOVERY (1W: +5.80% | 1M: -1.76%), DOW ABOVE TREND (1W: +10.04% | 1M: +8.98%) — news and momentum aligned. BEARISH: INTU CORRECTION (1W: -8.56% | 1M: +10.08%), WFC BELOW TREND (1W: -7.86% | 1M: -16.69%), BA BELOW TREND (1W: -9.18% | 1M: -11.16%) — earnings/news and price action confirm weakness.

**12. Sectors to Watch Next Week?**
BULLISH: Energy (1W: +2.38%, sector showing pockets of leadership; Energy: 8/10 positive). BEARISH: Financials (1W: -3.13%, Financials: 2/20 positive) and Technology (1W: -2.05%, Tech: 5/24 positive) as risk-off flows could deepen pressure.

**13. Key Levels & Triggers?**
NVDA 500 resistance (RECOVERY test), AAPL 150 support (BELOW TREND base), CVX 160 breakout level (ABOVE TREND continuation), XOM 110 support (ABOVE TREND). Breach or hold of these levels will signal broader sector follow-through or failure.

## 📰 NEWS SENTIMENT MOVERS

**14. Bullish Sentiment Stocks?**
APD (+55): APD RECOVERY (1W: +5.80% | 1M: -1.76%) — Wells Fargo upgrade and price bounce are confirming short-term accumulation. COP (+50): COP ABOVE TREND (1W: +4.12% | 1M: +10.46%) — target increases confirming price strength. TSLA (+50): TSLA BELOW TREND (1W: -1.39% | 1M: -8.66%) — positive headlines but price remains weak, a divergence to monitor.

**15. Bearish Sentiment Stocks?**
INTU (-55): INTU CORRECTION (1W: -8.56% | 1M: +10.08%) — weak guidance and sharp 1W drop confirm short-term distribution despite longer-term strength. LLY (-50): LLY BELOW TREND (1W: -0.53% | 1M: -2.81%) — recall headlines align with price weakness. ADBE (-50): ADBE BELOW TREND (1W: -12.09% | 1M: -3.05%) — downgrade and heavy 1W loss are confirming bearish sentiment.

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY
RISK-OFF, style mixed with a defensive tilt rather than clear growth leadership. Energy and select materials showing relative strength (XOM ABOVE TREND, CVX ABOVE TREND, DOW ABOVE TREND) while Tech and Financials are broadly weak. Key risk: MAJOR divergence among large-cap techs (NVDA, LRCX, INTC RECOVERY vs 1M weakness) and headline-driven hits to INTU/ADBE — watch for trend confirmation before reestablishing cyclical exposures.
